# mistershell_builtin_sensor_source (Data Source)

Reads existing backend-owned configuration without changing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_builtin_sensor_source" "existing" {
  name = "et/open"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Existing numeric ID, stable configuration key, or local.
- `name` (String) Exact unique lookup instead of numeric id. When both are supplied they must identify the same object.

### Read-Only

- `configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) configuration fields: enabled, parameters (sensitive string object). Built-in sources only. Parameters cannot be introduced or cleared because the API cannot remove them. Changing existing parameters requires restore_parameters with the original plaintext values. Enabling a source that would disable an enabled replacement is rejected. Masked secrets are returned as null.
